children.name: critical_anomaly_branch
children.condition: (user.last_ts > 0.0 && (geo.distance_km(user.last_lat, user.last_lon, payload.lat, payload.lon) / ((payload.timestamp - user.last_ts) / 3600.0)) > 900.0 && geo.distance_km(user.last_lat, user.last_lon, payload.lat, payload.lon) > 500.0) || (payload.amount > (user.all_time_max * 3.0) && !user.is_known_device)

children.name: safe_baseline_branch
children.condition: !((user.last_ts > 0.0 && (geo.distance_km(user.last_lat, user.last_lon, payload.lat, payload.lon) / ((payload.timestamp - user.last_ts) / 3600.0)) > 900.0 && geo.distance_km(user.last_lat, user.last_lon, payload.lat, payload.lon) > 500.0) || (payload.amount > (user.all_time_max * 3.0) && !user.is_known_device))
